subject: OpusEdge SIG evidence checkpoint & control mapping for pilot
messages:
From: Alex Hernandez <alex.hernandez@opusedge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@opusedge.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire & artifacts — pilot scope

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — we came away excited about Redwood's runtime and the unified deployment story. Procurement and our security team are moving the SIG questionnaire to the next stage for the pilot. Two quick asks to keep things on the fast path: 

1) Can you confirm the SOC 2 scope you will cite for the pilot (is it the standard Redwood production scope or a limited pilot scope)?
2) We need an initial evidence packet for the SIG controls we highlighted in the attached worksheet (link below). Can you share a short control mapping + artifacts plan by EOD Tuesday?

Our intake doc (partial) is here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OpusEdge-SIG-worksheet — I pasted the control IDs we care about in tab A. If you prefer, we can accept a zipped evidence index on S3/Drive.

Regards,
Alex
Alex Hernandez
Head of Platform Security, OpusEdge Systems
alex.hernandez@opusedge.com
https://opusedge.com

Attachments: (none inline)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Hernandez <alex.hernandez@opusedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire & artifacts — pilot scope

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet link. We can do the control mapping + evidence packet for the pilot scope. High level plan: 

- We will reference Redwood's production SOC 2 Type II report for the controls that cover hosted/live infra and our change management — we'll call out any pilot-scoped exceptions.
- For SIG-specific items you flagged (data residency, key management, access reviews) we'll provide explicit artifacts (config snapshot, KMS policy excerpt, access-review log sample) and a mapping CSV.
- Delivery: initial evidence-index.csv + SOC 2 summary PDF by EOD Tuesday (two business days). Full artifacts in S3 (pre-signed zip) within 72 hours after that.

Looping in Karthik and Marissa for the technical artifacts and to confirm whether any of the items require restricted redaction before delivery. Jasmine will coordinate the handoff with your procurement contact for any DPA/NDA steps.

Action items: 
- Karthik: confirm logs and sampling approach below.
- Marissa: prepare the evidence index + SOC 2 summary.
- Jasmine: poke procurement on the DocuSign link and confirm the billing contact.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Hernandez <alex.hernandez@opusedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire & artifacts — pilot scope

Alex / Ben — quick technical clarifications to make sure the artifacts meet SIG expectations: 

1) Data residency: OpusEdge asked for EU residency on some sample flows in the worksheet — confirm which environment (prod-us / staging-eu) you want evidence from. We can provide an infrastructure inventory snapshot for both, but log samples will be environment-specific.

2) KMS / Key provenance: we'll include a truncated KMS policy and the CMK creation event. For secrets rotation, do you need the full rotation job definition or just the rotation audit entries? We usually provide rotation audit entries (redacted) + job ID.

3) Access reviews: we will include a one-quarter sample of access review output (CSV) and a redacted list of privileged principals. For deeper attestation you may want the policy docs which are public links.

4) Telemetry/audit logs: we propose to provide a short sampled log file (30–90 minutes) and a parsing guide. Example filename: sample-kv-log.txt. Will that satisfy the operational evidence checks?

If yes, I'll mark those as "deliverables" in the evidence-index.csv for clarity. If you have specific control IDs you want mapped to each artifact, paste them into the worksheet and we'll mirror them in the CSV.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineering (Assurance Lead) — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Hernandez <alex.hernandez@opusedge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire & artifacts — pilot scope

Alex — attaching the initial artifacts as discussed. Please see the short descriptions in the evidence-index.csv; the SOC 2 summary highlights which controls are covered by our Type II report and which items are pilot-scoped exceptions.

Attachments (zipped for intake):
- evidence-index.csv — mapping of selected SIG controls to artifact filenames and redaction notes
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf — short summary of our SOC 2 Type II scope and how it relates to SIG control families
- sample-kv-log.txt — small, redacted log sample (30 mins) showing key usage and access events

Notes: 
- We redacted principal IDs in the access review sample; full IDs can be shared under an executed DPA/controlled S3 share.
- For data residency, we included inventory entries for both prod-us and staging-eu; let us know which you want prioritized.

Next steps: once you confirm receipt, Jasmine will coordinate a DocuSign link and a secure S3 share for the full artifact bundle.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Compliance & Controls — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: evidence-index.csv, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, sample-kv-log.txt

From: Alex Hernandez <alex.hernandez@opusedge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@opusedge.com, Laura Chen <laura.chen@opusedge.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire & artifacts — pilot scope

Marissa / Ben — received, thanks. The evidence-index looks good and the SOC 2 summary answers our immediate scope questions — we'll prioritize prod-us artifacts for the pilot (we'll call out a couple of controls in the worksheet that will need EU evidence later if we expand). Procurement has pushed the DocuSign link (see https://www.docusign.com/OPUS-23456) and asked for the S3 share details after the signed DPA.

I can confirm the sampled log file and the rotation audit entries meet our ops evidence checks for now. Once we have the signed DPA we'll request the full access review CSV and unredacted CMK events.

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Thursday to go over any follow-ups — Laura will send the invite.

Thanks,
Alex

Attachments: procurement/DocuSign link sent
